'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer/bla ma mchog gsum 'jam dpal lhar/ /gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro/bla med byang chub mcho

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer/ 1$0000290bla ma mchog gsum 'jam dpal lhar// gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro /bla med byang chub mchog thob phyir// 'jam dpal khrag 'thung bsgrub par bgyi// oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// sgyu ma lta bu'i cho 'phrul rtsal// zil gnon dkyil 'khor chen por shar// mthing nag e dbyings klu gnyan dang// sa bdag phyogs skyong ma he'i steng*// bdag nyid phyag rgya zil gnon sku /mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje g.yas// be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub g.yon// gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs bzhi bgrad// dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan// g.yon na yum chen gsod byed mthing*// tsitta thod khrag stob cing 'khyud// thugs kar ya ma rā dza smug /'khor lo snying 'dzin thugs ka na// phyag rdor ljang nag rdo rje dang*// snying 'dzin thugs kar ru sbal gnas// de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i dbus// mthing nag e yig sngags kyis bskor// spyi bor mkha' lding phrag par khyung*// sog par stag chen nu khar seng*// sta zur dug sbrul zung re 'gyed// ba spu khro tshogs mtshon cha 'bar// rngam brjid nam mkha' gang ba'i sku /gtum drag gshin rje'i tshogs kyis bskor// ma bcos lhun grub rdzogs sangs rgyas// gdod nas dag pa'i zil gnon dpal// 'khor 'das kun gyi dbang phyug che// gsal btab stong srog ayai ring bzla// ayai ayai ayai/ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ya ma ye oṃ/ kā la rū pa ka pa ye ām̐ḥ hrīṣṭi a pa ye hūm̐/ a a ne a ne/ u u ne u ne/ du du ne du ne/ a i u e o aṃ/ ra rī la lī/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ siṃ ha ye/ hri da ye/ bhi ta ye/ tsitta ye/ ha la ye/

mu ka ye/ u u ne u u ne/ byi tri ta/ a a nan/ ya ma rā dza/ ya ma raksha/ ya ma raka a/ ya ma rakṣa/ bai tā li kro dhī shwa rī ma ma e ka dzā ṭi/ dhe ma kha la baṃ ril/ ru lu ru lu/ shrī badzra kro dha ya ma karma ro ṣa na/ kro dha tsaṇḍa/ raksha monta/ āḥhūm̐ dzaḥ1$0000300

thun mtshams mchod bstod phrin las gsol/ snod bcud ye shes thig le cher// hūm̐ gis bsdu zhing 'khor 'das chos// ma bcos spros bral khyab brdal ba'i// 'od gsal chen po'i ngang mdangs bskyang*// 1$0000250de nas 1$0000290phaṭa 1$0000250ces 1$0000290thun mtshams lhar// chu las chu lbur bzhin du ldang*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /phyag rgya zil gnon 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /1$0000300 ces brjod rjes kyi spyod lam bskyang*// zil gnon sgom rim nyung ngu'i tshig /chen po'i 'dod ster bdud rtsi'i dpal// gang 'di 'gyur med rdo rje yi// blo mtsho'i dpyid las bskrun pa dge// /
